S20.01.needs: a signed-in account or a key set with Code: Set API Key
S20.01.note: Rendering is done by the reply; the model's wording decides the exact text.
steps: Click the AGI Code icon in the activity bar and sign in if asked.
Click the "Describe a task…" box, type "Write two short paragraphs about rain, separated by a blank line", press Enter.
Wait for the reply to finish and look at the reply: the two paragraphs should be separate, with space between them.
S20.01.where: AGI Code (activity bar) > "Describe a task…" box

steps: Click the AGI Code icon in the activity bar.

S20.26.needs: a signed-in account or a key set with Code: Set API Key

steps: Click the AGI Code icon in the activity bar and get a reply with a paragraph, a list and a code block.
Press the mouse at the start of the first paragraph and drag down past the list and into the code block.
Press Cmd+C, then paste into a text editor.
Look: the pasted text should include all the selected parts, in order, with no gaps.
